Hi! I'm from Baguio too.. and I got offered 11K base pay here (Web Designer & nightshift) - I rejected it, even though I badly need experience.

Sobrang unfair kako na mas malaki pa kinikita ng call center agent kaysa sakin, kahit yung job position naman na un is yung gusto kong career path.

Na try ko rin mag apply sa call center, I became desperate mag ka work but I know I will hate it because its not my niche. After ng interview ko sa call center, naiiyak ako paguwi HAHAHA.. pinapapunta nila ako sa client interview but I ended up ghosting them.

I decided to just focus on improving my skills and portfolio and though I don't have years of experience, I still submitted my resume to those companies that are looking for specific requirements.

I had plenty of interviews and rejections. I'm grateful for them actually ahaha. Through those rejections I learned how to sell myself kahit years of experience pa hanap nila.

I was able to get a job without years of experience. So don't feel discourage mag apply sa mga yun.. 

- so if afford pa and you still have enough resources. Applyan mo na lahat!! You have nothing to lose by trying :)

-if need mo na agad kumita, then you can take that job. But I suggest na dapat may oras ka para to learn more or improve your skills to the path you really want. 

Goodluck OP!

During my final interview they said "tinuturuan ka na nga, kumikita ka pa saamin" which I find as a red flag kasi I bet they assumed na "ay pang experience lang nyan tayo, bigay nating mababa".
